description: This file defines the LDAPUser class, a data transfer object (DTO) used within an LDAP authentication plugin for OrangeHRM. It manages LDAP user attributes, validation, and encapsulates LDAP entry data for synchronization purposes.

classes.name: LDAPUser
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a user fetched from LDAP, with attributes such as username, name, email, LDAP entry data, and associated validation and setter methods.

methods.name: getUserDN
methods.description: Returns the distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setUserDN
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user's distinguished name (DN); throws exception if length exceeds maximum.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username, validating its length against minimum and maximum constraints.

methods.name: getUserUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the user, if set.

methods.name: setUserUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the user's unique ID; logs warning if length exceeds maximum.

methods.name: isUserEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the LDAP user is enabled.

methods.name: setUserEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether the user is enabled.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setFirstName
methods.description: Sets the first name, validating its length.

methods.name: getMiddleName
methods.description: Returns the middle name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setMiddleName
methods.description: Sets the middle name, validating its length.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the last name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setLastName
methods.description: Sets the last name, validating its length.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID, if set.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID, validating its length.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email, if set.

methods.name: setWorkEmail
methods.description: Sets the work email, validating length and email format.

methods.name: setUserLookupSetting
methods.description: Associates LDAPUser with LDAP lookup settings.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Associates an LDAP Entry object with the user.

methods.name: getEmployeeSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Returns search filter parameters based on LDAP entry and lookup settings.

methods.name: getLogInfo
methods.description: Returns an array of LDAP entry DN and attributes for logging purposes.
